tagline.en: Three tolled tunnels in a line: Aberdeen, Cross-Harbour and Lion Rock, from the south side of Hong Kong Island to Sha Tin
tagline.zh: 三条收费隧道连成一线：香港仔、红磡海底与狮子山，自港岛南区直抵沙田

start.en: Aberdeen Praya Road in Aberdeen, on the south side of Hong Kong Island, by the junction for the Ap Lei Chau Bridge
start.zh: 香港岛南区香港仔海傍道，鸭脷洲大桥交汇处旁

end.en: Tai Po Road at Fo Tan in Sha Tin, where the road continues north as Route 9
end.zh: 沙田火炭大埔公路，其后以 9 号干线向北延续

en: Route 1 runs north for about 21 km from Aberdeen to Sha Tin, through seven districts: Southern, Wan Chai, Kowloon's Yau Tsim Mong, Kowloon City and Wong Tai Sin, and Sha Tin. It goes through the middle of everything — under the hill between Aberdeen and Happy Valley, over Causeway Bay on the Canal Road Flyover, under Victoria Harbour, up the spine of Kowloon on Princess Margaret Road and Waterloo Road, and under Lion Rock into the New Territories.

It is a chain of older roads rather than one road, and it shows. Apart from about 3 km of Sha Tin Road it is not an expressway, and the stretch of Waterloo Road through Kowloon Tong, between Flint Road and Suffolk Road, still has signalled junctions. Chinese Wikipedia counts it as the trunk route with the most traffic lights in Hong Kong, and the oldest. The busiest place on it is the approach to the Cross-Harbour Tunnel in Hung Hom, on Hong Chong Road.
zh: 1号干线自香港仔向北延伸约 21 公里至沙田，途经七个区：南区、湾仔区，九龙的油尖旺区、九龙城区、黄大仙区，以及沙田区。它从所有东西的中间穿过——在香港仔与跑马地之间钻过山体，经坚拿道天桥越过铜锣湾，从维多利亚港海底穿过，沿公主道和窝打老道纵贯九龙，再从狮子山底下进入新界。
它不是一条路，而是由一串较早建成的道路连接而成，这一点看得出来。除沙田路约 3 公里外，全线都不是快速公路；窝打老道九龙塘段在火石道与沙福道之间至今仍有交通灯路口。中文维基百科称它为全港交通灯最多、历史最悠久的干线。全线最繁忙的地方，是红磡康庄道上通往海底隧道的引道。

en: The Cross-Harbour Tunnel is 1.86 km of steel immersed tube: two two-lane tubes built from fifteen sections cast at the Whampoa dockyard and sunk into a trench in the harbour bed. Its south portal sits on Kellett Island, a former island joined to Hong Kong Island by the reclamation for the tunnel; its north end and toll plaza are on reclaimed land at Hung Hom Bay. It was designed for 80,000 vehicles a day, a figure it passed in the early 1980s.

Lion Rock Tunnel, about 1.4 km through the Kowloon ridge, was Hong Kong's first road tunnel and was dug as much for water as for cars: the bore carried water mains from the Plover Cove reservoir into the city along with its two traffic lanes. The second, parallel bore, opened in 1978 for northbound traffic, likewise carries water mains and a town-gas main to Sha Tin. Because the two tubes are far apart and have no cross-passages, a water-curtain fire system was fitted inside them in 1997, the only one in a Hong Kong tunnel.

The Aberdeen Tunnel, 1.85 to 1.9 km through granite, was driven by drilling and blasting. It has three cross-passages between its two tubes, and the University of Hong Kong had an underground particle-physics laboratory built between them during construction. About a thousand graves in the Hong Kong Cemetery were moved for the Happy Valley approach.
zh: 红磡海底隧道全长 1.86 公里，为钢制沉管隧道：两条双线管道由在黄埔船坞预制的十五节沉管组成，沉放于海床开挖的沟槽内。南端出入口位于奇力岛——原为海岛，因隧道工程填海而与港岛相连；北端及收费广场设于红磡湾填海区。设计容量为每日 8 万架次，这个数字在 1980 年代初便已被超过。
狮子山隧道约 1.4 公里，穿过九龙坳，是香港第一条行车隧道，而它的开凿既为行车也为供水：隧道在两条行车道之外同时容纳把船湾淡水湖食水输往市区的水管。1978 年启用、供北行使用的平行管道（第二狮子山隧道）同样设有水管，另有一条通往沙田的煤气管道。由于两条管道相距甚远、之间没有逃生通道，1997 年在管道内加装水帘系统，为全港隧道中所独有。
香港仔隧道长 1.85 至 1.9 公里，穿越花岗岩，以钻爆法开凿。两条管道之间有三条可行车的横通道；施工期间又应香港大学要求在两管之间加建了一间地下粒子物理实验室。为修建跑马地一侧的引道，香港坟场约有一千座坟墓迁移。

en: The oldest pieces are on the Kowloon side. Lion Rock Tunnel was begun in the early 1960s — May 1961 in the Hong Kong newspapers cited by Chinese Wikipedia, January 1962 in English Wikipedia — holed through on 20 November 1963 and opened on 14 November 1967 as a single tube carrying two-way traffic. Princess Margaret Road opened in 1966. A second Lion Rock bore was begun in January 1973, when Sha Tin was being built up as a new town, and opened on 18 January 1978.

The Cross-Harbour Tunnel was the first road across the harbour. Before it, vehicles crossed by ferry. The government chose a tunnel over a competing 1961 proposal for a bridge, which would have been high enough to endanger aircraft at Kai Tak. Governor David Trench started the work on 1 September 1969, and Governor Murray MacLehose opened it on 2 August 1972, about a year ahead of the contract programme. The Canal Road Flyover, which carries the route from the tunnel mouth over Causeway Bay, opened in March 1972.

The south end came last. The Aberdeen Tunnel had been planned since the 1960s but was put off after the 1973 stock-market crash and oil crisis left the government short of money. Work began on 10 May 1977, the first tube opened on 12 March 1982 and the second on 14 March 1983. Sha Tin Road opened in November 1984 and the Wong Chuk Hang Road flyover in December 2001.

The roads were put together under one number only in 2004, with Hong Kong's third route-numbering system; under the old numbering, in use since 1974, Route 1 had continued north along Tai Po Road, which went to the new Route 9.
zh: 最早的路段在九龙一侧。狮子山隧道于 1960 年代初动工——中文维基百科引用的香港报章记为 1961 年 5 月，英文维基百科记为 1962 年 1 月——1963 年 11 月 20 日贯通，1967 年 11 月 14 日以单管双程方式通车。公主道于 1966 年通车。1973 年 1 月，因应沙田发展为新市镇，第二条狮子山隧道动工，1978 年 1 月 18 日通车。
红磡海底隧道是第一条跨越维港的道路。此前车辆过海只能乘汽车渡轮。政府在 1961 年否决了一个与之竞争的跨海大桥方案，原因之一是大桥高度会危及启德机场的升降。1969 年 9 月 1 日，港督戴麟趾主持动工；1972 年 8 月 2 日，港督麦理浩主持通车，比合约工期提前约一年。由隧道口跨越铜锣湾的坚拿道天桥于同年 3 月通车。
南段最晚完成。香港仔隧道早于 1960 年代已有规划，但 1973 年股灾和第一次石油危机令政府资金紧绌，工程被押后。1977 年 5 月 10 日动工，首条管道 1982 年 3 月 12 日通车，第二条管道 1983 年 3 月 14 日通车。沙田路于 1984 年 11 月通车，黄竹坑道天桥于 2001 年 12 月通车。
这些道路直到 2004 年第三代干线编号系统实施时才归入同一个编号；在 1974 年起使用的旧编号下，1号干线原本还沿大埔公路继续北上，该段其后划归新的 9 号干线。

en: The three tunnels were paid for in three different ways. The Cross-Harbour Tunnel was Hong Kong's first build–operate–transfer project: the Cross-Harbour Tunnel Company, set up in 1965, financed and built it in return for a 30-year franchise to collect tolls, with the government holding about a fifth of the venture. Chinese Wikipedia puts the cost at HK$320 million; English Wikipedia says the company had recouped it within three and a half years of opening. The franchise ended in 1999, when the tunnel passed to the government.

Lion Rock and Aberdeen were built by the government. In 1977 the Cross-Harbour Tunnel Company offered to build the Aberdeen Tunnel on the same franchise terms; the government declined and paid for it from public funds, awarding a HK$280 million contract that May. The second Lion Rock bore was budgeted at HK$53 million in 1972.

All three are still tolled. The Cross-Harbour Tunnel's car toll began at HK$5 in 1972; since late 2023 it varies by time of day as part of a scheme to spread traffic across the three harbour tunnels, collected without toll booths.
zh: 三条隧道的出资方式各不相同。红磡海底隧道是香港首个“建造、营运、移交”（BOT）项目：1965 年成立的香港隧道有限公司负责融资和兴建，换取 30 年的收费专营权，政府则持有约两成权益。中文维基百科记其造价为 3.2 亿港元；英文维基百科称公司在通车后三年半便已收回建造成本。专营权于 1999 年届满，隧道归还政府。
狮子山隧道与香港仔隧道由政府出资兴建。1977 年，香港隧道有限公司曾提议以同样的专营模式兴建香港仔隧道，但政府拒绝，改由公帑支付，同年 5 月批出 2.8 亿港元的建造合约。第二狮子山隧道在 1972 年的预算为 5,300 万港元。
三条隧道至今仍然收费。红隧私家车收费在 1972 年为 5 港元；2023 年底起按时段收费，以分流三条过海隧道的车流，并已取消收费亭。

en: The Cross-Harbour Tunnel was full almost from the start and has been one of the most congested roads in Hong Kong ever since; the government added a passage tax in 1984 to discourage its use, with little effect. Queues from it back up along Hong Chong Road, Princess Margaret Road and Chatham Road on the Kowloon side and along the Canal Road Flyover on the island, where they in turn block the Aberdeen Tunnel; at peak times the Aberdeen Tunnel is closed intermittently at its toll plaza to keep traffic from stopping inside it. Lion Rock Tunnel remains the busiest tunnel in Hong Kong that does not cross the harbour.
zh: 红磡海底隧道几乎一通车便饱和，此后一直是香港最挤塞的道路之一；政府曾于 1984 年加征隧道通行税以抑制车流，但成效甚微。九龙一侧的车龙沿康庄道、公主道和漆咸道倒塞，港岛一侧则沿坚拿道天桥伸延，进而堵塞香港仔隧道；繁忙时间香港仔隧道会在收费广场实施间歇性封闭，以免车辆停滞在隧道内。狮子山隧道至今仍是全港最繁忙的非过海隧道。

en: Lion Rock Tunnel is being rebuilt. The Highways Department's plan is to dig a new three-lane bore between the two existing ones, then refurbish and widen the old southbound bore to three lanes and keep the 1978 bore in reserve for emergencies, while widening Lion Rock Tunnel Road to three lanes each way. The Legislative Council approved HK$240.7 million for design and site investigation in May 2023; works were expected to begin in 2025 and finish around 2033.
zh: 狮子山隧道正在改建。路政署的方案是在现有两条管道之间开凿一条三线行车的新管道，再把原南行管道翻新并扩阔为三线，1978 年的管道则留作紧急备用；狮子山隧道公路亦扩阔为三线双程。立法会财务委员会于 2023 年 5 月批出 2 亿 4,070 万港元，用于设计和工地勘测；工程预计 2025 年动工，约 2033 年完成。

en: The tunnels are limited to 70 km/h. Since 2023 all three have used HKeToll, which reads number plates and tags, and their toll booths have been removed. Driving north from Aberdeen, Route 1 is a tunnel, a flyover, a harbour tunnel, city streets with traffic lights, another tunnel, and finally a short expressway across the Shing Mun River on the Dragon Bridge.
zh: 各隧道限速每小时 70 公里。三条隧道自 2023 年起均采用“易通行”不停车缴费，收费亭已经拆除。从香港仔向北驾驶，1号干线依次是隧道、天桥、海底隧道、有交通灯的市区街道、又一条隧道，最后是一小段快速公路，经锦龙桥跨过城门河。

why.en: No cost has been published for Route 1 as a whole, which is a 2004 numbering of roads built separately between the 1960s and 2001. Figures for its tunnels are given separately below.
why.zh: 1号干线是 2004 年为 1960 年代至 2001 年间分别建成的多段道路所编的号码，没有整条路线的造价数字。各隧道的数字分列如下。

value.en: Mixed. The Cross-Harbour Tunnel was privately financed by the Cross-Harbour Tunnel Company under a 30-year build–operate–transfer franchise (1969–1999), with a government stake of about 20%. Lion Rock and Aberdeen tunnels and the surface roads were built by the Hong Kong government.
value.zh: 多种方式并存。红磡海底隧道由香港隧道有限公司以 30 年“建造、营运、移交”专营权（1969—1999 年）私人融资兴建，政府持股约两成；狮子山隧道、香港仔隧道及地面道路由香港政府兴建。

figures.source: English Wikipedia, Cross-Harbour Tunnel; Chinese Wikipedia, 海底隧道 (香港), 狮子山隧道, 香港仔隧道

value.en: HK$320 million (1969–1972). The figure is stated without a citation; it has not been checked against the company's accounts.
value.zh: 3.2 亿港元（1969—1972 年）。该数字未附出处，尚未与公司账目核对。

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 海底隧道 (香港)

value.en: HK$280 million construction contract, awarded May 1977; an earlier estimate in the early 1970s was HK$200 million
value.zh: 1977 年 5 月批出的建造合约为 2.8 亿港元；1970 年代初的估算为 2 亿港元

figures.source: 工商晚报, 10 May 1977; 华侨日报 and 大公报, 11 May 1977, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 香港仔隧道

value.en: Budgeted at HK$53 million in 1972; the French contractor's contract was reported at HK$29 million in January 1973
value.zh: 1972 年预算 5,300 万港元；1973 年 1 月报道法国承建商的合约总额为 2,900 万港元

figures.source: 华侨日报, 11 November 1972; 香港工商日报, 17 January 1973, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 狮子山隧道

label.zh: 狮子山隧道改善工程——设计

value.en: HK$240.7 million approved by the Finance Committee in May 2023 for design and site investigation, after HK$250.1 million was sought
value.zh: 2023 年 5 月财务委员会批出 2 亿 4,070 万港元作设计及工地勘测（原申请 2 亿 5,010 万港元）

figures.source: Legislative Council Public Works Subcommittee and Finance Committee, 2023, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 狮子山隧道

timeline.en: Princess Margaret Road opens in Kowloon.
Lion Rock Tunnel opens on 14 November, Hong Kong's first road tunnel, as a single tube with traffic both ways.
timeline.zh: 11 月 14 日，狮子山隧道通车，为香港第一条行车隧道，单管双程行车。

timeline.en: Work on the Cross-Harbour Tunnel begins on 1 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 1 日，红磡海底隧道动工。

timeline.en: The Canal Road Flyover opens in March; the Cross-Harbour Tunnel opens on 2 August, the first road under Victoria Harbour.
timeline.zh: 3 月坚拿道天桥通车；8 月 2 日红磡海底隧道通车，为首条穿越维港海底的道路。

timeline.en: Work on the Aberdeen Tunnel begins on 10 May.
timeline.zh: 5 月 10 日，香港仔隧道动工。

timeline.en: The Second Lion Rock Tunnel opens on 18 January, giving each direction its own bore.
timeline.zh: 1 月 18 日第二狮子山隧道通车，南北行从此各用一条管道。

timeline.en: The first Aberdeen Tunnel tube opens on 12 March; the second follows on 14 March 1983.
timeline.zh: 3 月 12 日香港仔隧道首条管道通车；第二条管道于 1983 年 3 月 14 日通车。

timeline.en: A passage tax is added to the Cross-Harbour Tunnel toll in June; Sha Tin Road opens in November.
timeline.zh: 6 月红隧加征隧道通行税；11 月沙田路通车。

timeline.en: The Cross-Harbour Tunnel franchise ends and the tunnel passes to the government.
timeline.zh: 红磡海底隧道专营权届满，隧道交还政府。

timeline.en: The third route-numbering system makes Aberdeen to Sha Tin Route 1; the old Route 1 north of Sha Tin becomes part of Route 9.
timeline.zh: 第三代干线编号系统实施，香港仔至沙田定为 1号干线；原 1号干线沙田以北路段划归 9 号干线。

timeline.en: HKeToll replaces the toll booths at the three tunnels; design funding for rebuilding Lion Rock Tunnel is approved.
timeline.zh: 三条隧道改用“易通行”，收费亭拆除；狮子山隧道改建工程的设计拨款获批。
